article.title: OpenAI推出ChatGPT for Sales，串連客戶資料與銷售工作
article.summary: OpenAI推出ChatGPT for Sales，包含Sales插件，以及逾30款新增或更新的合作夥伴插件。
highlights: 功能涵蓋客戶研究、會前準備、提案及跟進草稿。
合作插件的可用範圍受方案、地區和工作區設定影響，仍需各服務的授權。
article.why: 行銷與業務團隊可評估把客戶背景帶進同一段工作對話，減少整理提案時重複尋找資料。
article.next_step: 先選一個客戶工具連接，核對帳戶權限，再測試附有原始記錄連結的會議簡報。
article.detail: OpenAI的設定指引建議由一個客戶管理工具開始，完成所需連接及權限檢查。安裝Sales插件不會完成所有合作服務的帳戶授權，所需的付費訂閱仍由各服務處理。使用者可在同一對話草擬跟進和提出記錄更新，團隊可逐項對照來源資料並審閱支援的動作，再決定是否執行。
article.title_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Sales to connect customer context and workflows
article.summary_en: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Sales with its Sales plugin and more than 30 new or updated partner plugins.
highlights_en: Workflows include account research, meeting preparation, proposals and follow-up drafts.
Partner availability depends on plan, region and workspace settings and requires relevant service authorization.
article.why_en: Marketing and sales teams can assess bringing customer context into one conversation to reduce repeated searches during proposal work.
article.next_step_en: Connect one customer tool, check permissions and test a meeting brief with links to original records.
article.detail_en: OpenAI's guide suggests starting with one CRM and completing its connections and permission checks. Installing Sales does not authorize every partner account or provide required paid subscriptions. Users can draft follow-ups and propose record updates, then reconcile the sources and review supported actions before execution.
